metadata.title: Project Aurora - Sprint 14 Launch Alignment & Auth Migration
metadata.executive_summary: The engineering and product leadership aligned on critical architectural and release milestones for the Project Aurora Sprint 14 authentication overhaul. Key commitments include deprecating legacy v1 static API keys by November 15, 2026, and delivering schema migrations and frontend OAuth2 callback components by next week. However, a major timeline contradiction was detected between the Marketing press demo deployment requirement (Thursday 2 PM) and the Security penetration audit freeze (ending Friday 4 PM). Furthermore, several tasks currently lack assigned owners or defined scope.

decisions.decision: Deprecate all API v1 static keys; enforce v2 Bearer token authentication.
decisions.context: Dual-stack token support poses high maintenance overhead and security attack surface.
decisions.decided_by: Sarah Chen (VP of Product), endorsed by David Miller and Marcus Vance

decisions.decision: Phased mobile biometric rollout: Ship iOS Biometric Auth in v14.1, defer Android to v14.2.
decisions.context: iOS FaceID/TouchID is QA-certified, while Android has unresolved device-specific edge cases on Samsung OneUI.
decisions.decided_by: Sarah Chen (VP of Product), based on recommendation by Elena Rostova

decisions.decision: Shift weekly engineering sync from Monday 9:00 AM EST to Tuesdays at 10:00 AM EST.
decisions.context: Resolves standing conflict with company-wide standup.

tasks.title: Deliver PostgreSQL Session Schema Migration Script
tasks.description: Finalize the complete PostgreSQL schema redesign and migration scripts for user sessions, dropping legacy token structures.

tasks.title: Implement Frontend OAuth2 Callback & Login UI
tasks.description: Build and unit-test the OAuth2 callback handler and Google/GitHub authentication components in React.

tasks.title: Deploy Redis Rate Limiting on /auth/token
tasks.description: Configure and deploy Redis token-bucket rate-limiting rules on the auth gateway to prevent credential stuffing and brute-force attacks.

tasks.title: Purge Orphan Test Records from Staging DB
tasks.description: Clean up stale test rows and orphan user session tokens from the staging database prior to running the migration script.

unresolved_questions.question: Are enterprise SSO customers on custom Okta integrations grandfathered into the legacy 30-day session expiry, or must they strictly rotate at 8 hours?
unresolved_questions.relevant_stakeholders: Sarah Chen (Product), Enterprise Support, Legal / SLA Team

unresolved_questions.question: Does migrating the encryption key management service to AWS KMS before December trigger a requirement for a formal SOC2 external re-certification, or is it covered under the current Type II report?
unresolved_questions.relevant_stakeholders: External Compliance Auditor, Legal, Marcus Vance

follow_ups.item: Sync with Enterprise Support regarding enterprise Okta session duration SLAs and contractual obligations.
Execute load benchmark on PostgreSQL write latency under 10,000 concurrent login bursts.
follow_ups.notes: Validates scalability of the new session table indexes.

follow_ups.item: Resolve Staging Deployment vs. Security Freeze escalation with leadership and Marketing.
follow_ups.notes: High priority blocker impacting marketing campaign demo.

contradictions_and_ambiguities.summary: Marketing Staging Deployment vs. Mandatory Security Freeze Violation
contradictions_and_ambiguities.issue_description: Sarah stated that the backend staging build must be deployed and stable by Thursday, Nov 6 at 2:00 PM EST for Marketing press assets. However, Marcus announced a company-wide freeze policy for an automated security penetration audit running from Thursday morning through Friday, Nov 7 at 4:00 PM EST. Deploying on Thursday will violate compliance protocol and invalidate test telemetry.

conflicting_statements.speaker: Sarah Chen
conflicting_statements.statement: Marketing has a press briefing demo scheduled for Thursday afternoon. So we need the backend staging build completely deployed and stable by Thursday, November 6th at 2:00 PM EST.
conflicting_statements.assertion: Staging deployment required by Thursday 2:00 PM EST.

conflicting_statements.speaker: Marcus Vance
conflicting_statements.statement: We have a company-wide freeze policy: no staging deployments are permitted until the security audit finishes and clears on Friday, November 7th at 4:00 PM EST. A deployment on Thursday afternoon will invalidate the scan and violate protocol.
conflicting_statements.assertion: Staging deployments strictly forbidden until Friday 4:00 PM EST.

contradictions_and_ambiguities.recommended_action: Sarah Chen and Marcus Vance must align immediately. Either: (a) Reschedule the Marketing press recording to Friday after 4:00 PM EST / Monday morning, or (b) Spin up an isolated, sanitized pre-staging sandbox for Marketing that does not interfere with the audited staging environment.

contradictions_and_ambiguities.issue_description: David noted that staging database test records must be purged prior to migration. However, Elena clarified she lacks permissions, and David suggested 'someone on ops or backend... grab it whenever they get a chance'. Without an assigned owner or deadline, this prerequisite risks being missed, threatening the schema migration.

conflicting_statements.speaker: David Miller
conflicting_statements.statement: Someone on ops or backend should probably purge the orphan test records and stale session rows from the staging database before we run any migration.
conflicting_statements.assertion: Task identified as prerequisite without designated owner.

conflicting_statements.speaker: Elena Rostova
conflicting_statements.statement: I don't have database write permissions in staging.

conflicting_statements.speaker: David Miller
conflicting_statements.statement: Yeah, no worries, someone can just grab it whenever they get a chance or have some spare bandwidth.
conflicting_statements.assertion: Task left unassigned with open-ended timeline.

contradictions_and_ambiguities.recommended_action: Explicitly assign Task TASK-04 to David Miller (Backend) or Marcus Vance (DevOps) with a hard deadline of Tuesday, November 4, 2026 (prior to Wednesday's migration).

contradictions_and_ambiguities.summary: Vague Scope: User Profile Settings UI Revamp
contradictions_and_ambiguities.issue_description: Sarah informally suggested revamping the user profile settings UI with Tailwind if 'someone has a couple spare hours'. Elena warned that frontend capacity is already at 95%. Sarah left it 'fluid'. This creates risk of unofficial scope creep and divergent expectations.

conflicting_statements.speaker: Sarah Chen
conflicting_statements.statement: Also, looking ahead, maybe we can revamp the user profile settings UI with the new Tailwind theme if someone has a couple spare hours this sprint?
conflicting_statements.assertion: Proposes ad-hoc UI redesign within current sprint.

conflicting_statements.speaker: Elena Rostova
conflicting_statements.statement: Is that officially in scope for Sprint 14? Our frontend sprint capacity is already at 95% with the OAuth callback flow.
conflicting_statements.assertion: Flags capacity saturation and scope ambiguity.

conflicting_statements.speaker: Sarah Chen
conflicting_statements.statement: Let's keep it fluid. We'll see how Sprint 14 shakes out and decide later if anyone happens to have extra capacity.
conflicting_statements.assertion: Leaves scope unbounded rather than firmly deferring.

contradictions_and_ambiguities.recommended_action: Formally de-scope the User Profile UI revamp from Sprint 14 and backlog it for Sprint 15 planning to protect Elena's capacity for the OAuth2 deliverable.
